Hi Phoebe! I'm sharing the final delivery folder via the link below. Here's a quick overview of what's included and a few notes before you send everything to your supplier.
The folder contains the four production-ready pareo files, the tile files for the Zebra Savanna and Diagonal Basket Weave, and the Technical Sheet with all colour references and file specifications. There's also a README with a full description of the folder contents.
A note on the Basket Weave colours: as we worked through the revision process, the palette shifted from your original reference to better match the real woven texture you shared. The Pantone and CMYK values in the Technical Sheet reflect the final adjusted tones, not the original palette. This is documented in the Technical Sheet notes for your supplier's reference.
The tiles are included as a bonus. They're not needed for the current production run but could be useful if you'd like to print the designs on other products beyond the pareos, anything that works with a repeating pattern.
The folder will be available for download for 30 days, until 10/07/2026. Please make sure everything is downloaded before that date.
<https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Y8MXVtLMJdYLcYupvleeLGoW-G7W_5qe?usp=sharing>

Looking forward to hearing from you
Orne
